name: Concentration Account 1
definition: Bank account used by a central counterparty to concentrate cash funds before or after investment.

OutFlow.name: Out Flow
OutFlow.definition: Indicates outflows out of the account.

EndOfDay.name: End Of Day
EndOfDay.definition: Indicates end of day cash balance on the account.

PeakCredit.name: Peak Credit
PeakCredit.definition: Indicates peak credit balance on the account.

PeakDebit.name: Peak Debit
PeakDebit.definition: Indicates peak debit balance on the account.

LatePaymentConfirmation.name: Late Payment Confirmation
LatePaymentConfirmation.definition: Number of concentration account pay‐ins breaching the allowed time between instruction and confirmation. Usage: nil returns to be included for late payment confirmations in all cleared currencies.
